title: Snapchat Symbols: Copy & Paste 👻 ✨ Bio Decorations & Friend Emoji Guide
meta_description: Copy and paste Snapchat bio and username symbols — ghost 👻, sparkles ✨, fire 🔥, sunglasses 😎 — plus a plain-English guide to Snapchat's streak, heart, and friend emoji badges.
hero_tagline: Ghost, sparkle, fire, and heart symbols to decorate your Snapchat name and captions, plus a plain-English guide to what the streak fire, hourglass, and friend emoji badges actually mean. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: Snapchat culture runs on two different kinds of symbols. The first is the copy-paste kind — ghosts 👻, sparkles ✨, fire 🔥, and hearts that people add to a display name, bio, or caption to make it stand out, all free to grab below. The second is Snapchat's own Friend Emoji system — the small badges next to a friend's name that track your Snapstreak, show how deep a best-friendship runs, and flag new friends and birthdays. This page covers both: a full copy-paste symbol set first, then an honest explainer of how the Friend Emoji badges work. That system is customizable, so treat it as the long-standing classic default rather than a fixed chart, and check your own Settings > Friend Emojis for your current set.
